architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely. Channel services (outside the system boundary) may call capability REST APIs synchronously. SVC-017 is a CHANNEL service — it is NOT a capability service and sits outside the system boundary.

channel_services.capability_note: SVC-017 is not a capability in the architectural sense. It is the Open Banking API surface layer. It holds no persistent domain state — ENT-030 and ENT-031 are owned by SVC-001. SVC-017 may call capability REST APIs synchronously (channel → capability is permitted).
channel_services.role_in_journey: Exposes the OBIE-compliant Domestic Payment Consents API and Domestic Payments API. Handles TPP authentication (client credentials flow to SVC-100), consent redirect orchestration, and status response mapping. Routes payment initiation to SVC-001 via synchronous REST.

consumed_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Updates the internal payment status cache so that TPP GET /domestic-payments/{id} polls return AcceptedSettlementCompleted with fps_reference.

consumed_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentFailed
consumed_events.purpose: Updates the internal payment status cache to Rejected. Maps internal failure_reason to OBIE-standard error code for the TPP poll response.

consumed_apis.purpose: POST /open-banking-consents — create ENT-030 at PH-036. POST /payments (with consent_id) — create ENT-008 at PH-038. GET /payments/{id} — status lookup for TPP polling at PH-040.
Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) at PH-035. Authorisation server for consent redirect and SCA at PH-037. Token endpoint for TPP access token exchange at PH-038.

consumed_events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Sanctions check result for open-banking-initiated PaymentIntent. Clear + EVT-181 non-block: publish EVT-182 (PaymentCleared) and subsequently EVT-062 when payment completes. Hit: publish EVT-185 (PaymentFailed) and EVT-063 (OpenBankingPaymentFailed). Idempotent on payment_intent_id.

consumed_events.name: FraudScoreCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Fraud risk result for open-banking-initiated PaymentIntent. Non-block + EVT-180 clear: publish EVT-182. Block: publish EVT-186 (PaymentFraudBlocked) and EVT-063 (OpenBankingPaymentFailed).

consumed_events.name: PaymentExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: FPS submission confirmed by SVC-009. SVC-001 debits the account ledger, sets PaymentIntent.status = completed, publishes EVT-184 (AccountDebited) and EVT-062 (OpenBankingPaymentCompleted).

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous REST — token introspection to validate access tokens presented by SVC-017
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-001 calls SVC-100 to introspect the TPP access token bound to consent_id before processing a POST /payments request. Ensures the token is valid, not expired, and scoped to 'payments'.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001 owns both ENT-030 (OpenBankingConsent) and ENT-031 (TPPRegistration), not SVC-017.
design_decisions.rationale: See DD-JRN010-01 and DD-JRN010-04 in journey-detail.json. Consent is a PSR-regulated customer-account aggregate. TPP registration is a bank-level regulatory record. Both belong in the core banking domain, co-located with Customer (ENT-001) and Account (ENT-004).

design_decisions.decision: ENT-030.status = consumed is set atomically in the same transaction as ENT-008 creation during PH-038. If the PaymentIntent creation fails, the consent reverts to authorised (rollback).
design_decisions.rationale: Prevents a race condition where the consent is consumed but no PaymentIntent exists — which would leave the TPP with a consumed consent and no payment_id, with no ability to retry.

consumed_events.name: PaymentCleared
consumed_events.purpose: Triggers FPS submission for open-banking-initiated payments (same consumer as JRN-002). SVC-009 creates ENT-009 (PaymentExecution), constructs ISO 20022 pacs.008, submits to Vocalink FPS. Publishes EVT-183 on FPS acceptance.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-009 does not distinguish between direct payments (JRN-002) and open-banking-initiated payments (JRN-010) at the FPS submission layer. Both arrive via EVT-182 with the same schema.
design_decisions.rationale: The FPS rail does not carry OB provenance — the pacs.008 message format is the same regardless of origination channel. The OB-specific distinction (consent_id, tpp_id) lives in ENT-008 and the openbanking.payments topic, not in the FPS execution layer.

consumed_events.name: PaymentIntentCreated
consumed_events.purpose: Triggers concurrent sanctions screening of payee (name, sort code, account number) for open-banking-initiated payments. Reuses the JRN-002 consumer pattern. Publishes EVT-180 (SanctionsScreeningCompleted). Must complete within 2 seconds P99.

consumed_events.name: PaymentIntentCreated
consumed_events.purpose: Triggers concurrent ML fraud scoring for open-banking-initiated payments. Reuses the JRN-002 consumer pattern. OB payments receive an additional feature: tpp_id and consent_id are included in the fraud feature vector (TPP-level fraud pattern detection). Publishes EVT-181 (FraudScoreCompleted). Must complete within 500ms P99.

design_decisions.decision: tpp_id is included as a feature in the fraud scoring model for OB-initiated payments.
design_decisions.rationale: PISP-initiated payments present a different fraud risk profile from direct customer-initiated payments — the TPP's historical fraud rate, the volume of payments from this TPP to this payee, and the match between consent details and payment details are all relevant fraud signals. Including tpp_id enables TPP-level fraud detection without changing the core EVT-179/EVT-181 contract.

services.role_in_journey: Acts as the OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authorisation server for the Open Banking programme. Issues client credentials at DCR (PH-035), orchestrates the authorisation code flow and SCA at PH-037, and issues access tokens to TPPs at PH-038. Token introspection endpoint called by SVC-001 on each payment initiation request.

consumed_events.name: ConsentAuthorised
consumed_events.purpose: Sends consent confirmation push notification to PER-001.

consumed_events.name: ConsentRevoked
consumed_events.purpose: Sends consent revocation notification to PER-001 (dashboard revocation scenario only).

consumed_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentInitiated
consumed_events.purpose: Sends in-progress push notification to PER-001.

consumed_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: Sends payment success push notification to PER-001 including fps_reference.

consumed_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentFailed
consumed_events.purpose: Sends customer-safe failure notification to PER-001. Must not disclose fraud or sanctions failure reasons.

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: TPP calls OBIE-compliant endpoints on SVC-017 for DCR, consent creation, payment initiation, and status polling.
SVC-017 calls SVC-001 to create ENT-030 (consent creation), create ENT-008 (payment initiation), and read PaymentIntent status for TPP polling.
SVC-017 uses SVC-100 as OAuth 2.0 authorisation server for DCR, SCA orchestration, and token issuance.

cross_service_interaction_summary.interaction_type: Async event — EVT-179 published; EVT-180 and EVT-181 consumed
cross_service_interaction_summary.description: Standard JRN-002 payment screening pattern reused in full.

cross_service_interaction_summary.interaction_type: Async event — EVT-182 published; EVT-183 consumed
cross_service_interaction_summary.description: Standard JRN-002 FPS execution pattern reused in full.
